Situation Report — Day 27 (last 2 hours)

  • Diplomacy / Talks
    • US envoys en route to Doha for “perhaps important” Iran meeting. (Trump)

  • Airspace / Flights
    • Regional airspace disruption: airports closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan (02:00 scan).
    • Early scan showed 306 aircraft; later 776 aircraft with one military track (RCH5017) over region.
    • Civilian flights heavily constrained; expect continued closures while strikes/patrols continue.
  • Economy / Markets
    • Oil prices dipped as markets focus on possible Doha talks.
    • Wall Street gained; Dow hit record close amid fragile truce signals.
  • Northern Border / Lebanon
    • Analysts: recent Israel-Lebanon arrangements may entrench a stalemate rather than end fighting.
  • Operational context
    • Previous 5-day pause was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — risk of repeat violations remains.
    • Air superiority and strike sorties continue to shape diplomatic leverage.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pause extension + envoys moving to Doha create a real, short-term opening for de-escalation.
  • Threat assessment: stable

  • מרחב אווירי / טיסות
    • שיבוש אזורי: נמלי תעופה סגורים באיראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון וירדן (סריקה 02:00).

    • מחירי הנפט ירדו כשהמשקיעים מתמקדים באפשרות לשיחות בדוחא.

    • אנליסטים: הסדרים בין ישראל ללבנון עלולים להטמיע תקיעות במקום לפתור את הלחימה.
  • הקשר מבצעי
    • הפסקת החמישה ימים הקודמת נפרצה עם תקיפות באיספהאן ובח'ורמסשהאר — יש סיכון להפרות נוספות.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הארכת ההשהיה ושליחת שליחים לדוחא יוצרים חלון אמיתי, קצר-טווח, להורדת מתיחות.

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes/sirens:

  • Ceasefire / Negotiations: Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. US envoys enroute to Doha; Pakistan mediating. Tactical context: first 5-day pause was violated within hours.
  • Air campaign & strikes: Recent strikes hit multiple Iranian sites in last 48h. Israeli strikes also hit Gaza humanitarian zones (civilian casualties reported). Air defenses in Israel remain active; regional airports largely closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan).
  • Northern border: Daily Hezbollah exchanges. Israel-Lebanon security annex text published; talks include phased IDF redeployment. IDF expanding counter-drone/warning systems (AI radar contract awarded).

  • International moves: Italy allowed US planes to use bases. Pakistan mediating. Negotiators reportedly heading to Doha. Russia notified UN on suspects in unrelated bus strike.
  • Cyber: At least one critical cyber incident detected in region.
  • 🟢 Good News: US announced pause; envoys moving to Doha; Pakistan mediation; Israel contracting AI-based drone warning tech.
Threat assessment: De-escalating (fragile).
